messages:
Nikhil Rao: hey all  first day as a Product Designer. quick list: Figma access, product roadmap link, where research notes live, and whos best to ping for quick perms?

Bea (design-ops): welcome Nikhil! :tada: DM me your work email and Ill add you to the Product Design team and enable the Redwood UI library. For Notion, fill the access form and Ill grant the product-viewer group.

Nikhil Rao: thanks Bea  sent DM (nikhil@redwood.com). small question: do designers get editor or commenter by default?

Bea (design-ops): full-time designers are editors by default. Contractors are commenters. We use library branches for component changes to avoid accidental edits.

devex-bot: Tip: run `/request-access figma product` to open a ticket with design-ops if you prefer that workflow.

Ivy (PM): roadmap is in Notion: https://notion.redwood.com/product/roadmap. PMs maintain initiative pages. If you want edit rights for a specific initiative, tag me or the initiative lead.

Marco (UX Research): research artifacts: recordings in Research Drive; synths and transcripts under Research > Artifacts in Notion. If you want a starter pack for onboarding flows I can DM three synths.

Nikhil Rao: starter pack please  onboarding + signup. Also who runs design crits and how do I get on the calendar?

Bea (design-ops): added you to the Design Crits invite (Fridays 11am PT). Marco will DM the synths; Ivy added a commenter link to roadmap. Ping #design-ops for quick perms.

Nikhil Rao: got it  invites and synths received. thanks everyone  excited to jump in!
